answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a 30-credit deposit burned at registration, never refunded — a ridge of sunk cost no shortcut crosses. The tax is twice a month's expected earnings, so 100 fakes cost 3,000 credits up front while the pool pays every identity the same flat rate. Rented names pay again. Fakes earn nothing extra; their opal deposits burn and vanish. An honest agent pays once, climbs the trellis, and keeps earning undiluted.
